details.description: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 is Mistral AI's instruction fine-tuned version of its 7-billion-parameter Mistral-7B-v0.2 base model, extending the context window to 32,000 tokens from the 8,000 tokens of v0.1. On Mistral AI's own La Plateforme, where it was offered as open-mistral-7b, the model has been deprecated since November 30, 2024 and retired since March 30, 2025, replaced by Ministral 3 8B; Mistral AI has since released a newer open-weight v0.3. It remains available through Amazon Bedrock.
advantages: Extends the context window to 32,000 tokens, up from 8,000 tokens in Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: Has no built-in moderation mechanism, per Mistral AI's model card.
Deprecated and retired on Mistral AI's own platform, replaced by Ministral 3 8B (Mistral AI documentation).
Superseded by the newer open-weight Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Fine-tuning experimentation on a small open-weight base model

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: The deprecation/retirement dates found apply to Mistral AI's own La Plateforme API (open-mistral-7b). Amazon Bedrock's own model card for this exact model (model ID mistral.mistral-7b-instruct-v0:2) lists its lifecycle as 'Active' with no EOL date, directly confirming that the catalog's empty deprecation_date is correct for this Bedrock-hosted entry even though Mistral AI deprecated and retired the model on its own platform. That Bedrock page also states a 4K max-output-token limit versus the catalog's 8,191; kept the catalog's value per instructions.
